about_the_game:
"I left a love note..."

MISSING YOUR SERIAL KILLER VALENTINES? 
THEY'VE BEEN MISSING YOU TOO...

Show the Killer Chat! dev team some love this Valentine's day and you'll get some exclusive rewards from your murderous lover in these Valentine's day bundles! 

I invested my own money and the games' earnings so far to pay the team and need your help to continue to fund the team's hard work. Donate through one of our bundles below for some extra serial killer loving while we work on more game content!

OUR ULTIMATE BUNDLE INCLUDES ALL OF THE FOLLOWING... 

༯ LOVE LETTERS!

x4 love letters from your love interests (PDF file)

༯ VOICE-ACTED LOVE LETTER!

Ronin, Angel, Misaki and V read their love letter out loud! (MP4 file; voiced by Jett Barker, Emilie Brewer, sirsamgrace, and Jason Hall)

༯ EXCLUSIVE RONIN ARTWORK!

x1 bonus exclusive Ronin art to thank you for your patience for Ronin's voice-acted love letter, as the SAG-AFTRA strike was underway.

༯ ADD A VALENTINE'S SHORT STORY TO YOUR PREVIOUS REWARDS!

x4 Valentine's short stories about your serial killer love interest! (PDF)
